compiled_state.title: [GREEN] Attach backfill run log and stats output to epic 4911-c7ba as ticket comments
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
This task satisfies DD3: both outputs (backfill run log and retro session output) are attached to the epic ticket as comments with the tag-count result and retro finding line cited explicitly.

## Implementation Steps
1. Using the captured T1 output:
   .claude/scripts/dso ticket comment 4911-c7ba "SC6_EVIDENCE_BACKFILL: ticket=<id> slug=<slug> tag=bug-type-<slug> tag-count-result=$(count of bug-type-* tags excluding uncategorized on closed bugs)"

2. Using the captured T2 output:
   .claude/scripts/dso ticket comment 4911-c7ba "SC6_EVIDENCE_STATS: retro_finding_line=<first labeled finding line or health message from stats output> full_output=<full stdout from bug-classification-stats.sh --window-days 60>"

3. Verify both comments are visible on the epic:
   .claude/scripts/dso ticket show 4911-c7ba | python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); comments=[c for c in d.get('comments',[]) if 'SC6_EVIDENCE' in c.get('body','')]; print(len(comments))"

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh 2>&1 | tail -3
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Epic ticket 4911-c7ba has at least 2 SC6_EVIDENCE_* comments
  Verify: .claude/scripts/dso ticket show 4911-c7ba 2>/dev/null | python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); c=[x for x in d.get('comments',[]) if 'SC6_EVIDENCE' in x.get('body','')]; print(len(c)); exit(0 if len(c)>=2 else 1)"

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
